description.value: Cit-E Cycles is BC's largest e-bike retailer, founded in Langley in 2011 and now operating six locations across the province, with this Langley address serving as its headquarters. The shop carries 300+ e-bike models from 20+ premium brands spanning urban, mountain, touring, cargo, folding, and trike categories. Touring cyclists will find one of the widest e-bike selections in Canada along with in-store service and repair.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Langley HQ location of Cit-E Cycles at 19981 96 Ave, matching the OSM address. The contact page explicitly lists 'Service & Repairs' as a service subject option and provides a phone number (1-855-557-7900) absent from OSM. No explicit evidence for a floor pump, walk-in repair policy, or most cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
